_: Copy this directory to presets/<hw>-<model>/ and fill every <...>. Engine URLs are the addresses engines serve HTTP on and NIXL moves KV over - fabric addresses on a multi-NIC fleet. Roles are the opening split only; the controller moves them.
model: <served model name - every engine must serve exactly this>
